SessionStart.command: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/go/bin:$HOME/.local/go/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ ! -x "./bin/hq" ] && [ ! -x "../bin/hq" ] && [ ! -x "../../../bin/hq" ]; then go build -o ./bin/hq ./cmd/hq 2>/dev/null; elif [ -d "./cmd/hq" ] && [ -n "$(find cmd internal -name '*.go' -newer ./bin/hq 2>/dev/null)" ]; then go build -o ./bin/hq ./cmd/hq 2>/dev/null && ./bin/hq migrate --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi; ("./bin/hq" hook session-start 2>/dev/null || "../bin/hq" hook session-start 2>/dev/null || "../../../bin/hq" hook session-start)

hooks.command: ("./bin/hq" hook pre-tool 2>/dev/null || "../bin/hq" hook pre-tool 2>/dev/null || "../../../bin/hq" hook pre-tool)

Stop.command: ("./bin/hq" hook stop 2>/dev/null || "../bin/hq" hook stop 2>/dev/null || "../../../bin/hq" hook stop)
